name: Bezique
summary: Two-player point-trick melding game where players declare combinations and fight for valuable tricks to first reach 1000 points.
rules_text: Use two 52-card decks stripped of 2s-6s, 64 cards rank A high, 10, K, Q, J, 9, 8, 7. Deal 8 cards each, remaining stock with top card face-up defining trumps. Phase 1: Non-dealer leads. Players need not follow suit; highest trump or highest of led suit wins, leader wins ties. After winning, player may declare exactly one meld, lay those cards face-up scoring points, and may exchange the 7 of trumps for the upturned trump. Then winner draws from stock first, then loser. Melds: Bezique Qs+Jd 40, double Bezique 500, royal marriage K+Q trump 40, common marriage 20, four Aces 100, four Kings 80, four Queens 60, four Jacks 40, trump sequence A-10-K-Q-J 250. A declared meld stays on table but can be reused in other melds. Phase 2 when stock empty: 8 tricks, must follow suit if able, otherwise trump if able. Score 10 per Ace and 10 taken, plus 10 for last trick. First to 1000 over multiple deals wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking meld game, hidden hands, sequential choices, strategic.
